Context: IX. Constant Attendant Allowance:

Eligible for the awards under this rule also. Where the benefit admissible under this rule is more than the benefits admissible under the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923, (VIII of 1923), the compensation admissible under the said Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923, shall not be separately payable.
